description:
Powerful and intelligent flash cards.

Anki is a program which makes remembering things easy.
Because it's a lot more efficient than traditional study methods, you can either greatly decrease your time spent studying, or greatly increase the amount you learn.
Anyone who needs to remember things in their daily life can benefit from Anki.
Since it is content-agnostic and supports images, audio, videos and scientific markup (via LaTeX), the possibilities are endless.
## What's Changed

⚠️ Please upgrade to [26.09](https://github.com/ankitects/anki/releases/tag/26.09)+ as soon as possible as it includes important security fixes.

### Fixes

• Fix system-wide app upgrades on Windows not properly replacing old versions and causing startup crashes by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5626
• Fix "Card modified" error in the Cards Info screen when FSRS disabled or memory state is missing by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5648
• Append app version to the extracted tarball directory name on Linux by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5662
• Force software rendering in safe mode by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5637
• Fix the "Please restart to save changes" message shown multiple times in the preferences screen in some cases by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5641

### Documentation

• Improve manual translation instructions by @wofiporia in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5519

### Development

• Update Python dependencies to match bundled dependencies in 26.05+ by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5625
• Update Rust dependencies to fix CI failure by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5608
• Add tests for config.py and stdmodels.py by @roostwp07 and @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5513
• CI：Track releases in the SonarCloud project version by @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5634
• CI：Fetch PR base branch so SonarCloud diffs only changed files by @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5659
• Refactor：use col.fsrs_enabled in more places by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5651

## New Contributors

• @wofiporia made their first contribution in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5519
